snippets.snippet: General Application Requirements in Designated A Zones • Submission of materials required in a designated AE or AH zone. • Designation of the floodway boundaries • Designation of the base flood elevations • Computer model input and output used to determine the existing base flood elevation and floodway limits. • Computer model input and output used to determine the base flood elevation and floodway elevation using the existing floodway limits with the proposed development completed. • Any additional information or exhibits deemed necessary for property consideration of the application.
